method: Actual production halcVisibleUnits + HalcBoundaries settle/refreshLabels + HalcRegions source-order handling + regionalAnchor; shipped MapLibre lazy Feature and two real local/regional MVT tiles. Map event bus, screen projection, DOM/Marker and render/GPU boundary are deterministic test doubles. Eager control uses prior eager grouping and an independent frozen 3.42 synchronous refreshLabels body. Every production marker comparison awaits the actual current scheduler promise through commit; geometry instrumentation remains active across asynchronous slices. No speed claim.
conditions: active && !loading && showLabels && anchor; zoom<8 and regions.ready===false chooses locality candidates. All candidates passing TYPE!=8, nonempty ADM1, ADM1!=XX and no semicolon are anchored before marker limit/name collision filtering, materializing all their fragment geometry.
limitations: The viewport query returns this bounded real tile through the map fixture; viewport clipping is not independently retested.
Projection is a deterministic geographic-to-screen transform, not actual MapLibre projection or browser pixels.
Label equivalence and exact geometry are verified; CPU/GPU memory, browser latency, worldwide completeness and all source-order permutations are not claimed.
Fallback intentionally retains its eager demand for every qualifying candidate; the test does not require a speedup in that path.
